tables.MenuItems: one row per JSON array element
tables.Notifications: one row per order including zero-event orders
tables.ItemPairs: one row per order and distinct unordered pair

notes: Notifications is unique by order; configure 1:* to retain Orders-to-Notifications filtering, not bidirectional 1:1.
No additional Date-to-lines relationship: avoid ambiguous paths.
Product filters intentionally affect menu measures only; do not make order totals appear product revenue.
Pairs use name_a/name_b from ItemPairs as visual axes; product slicers do not filter pairs.
